[[File:Valentintournebize avatar.jpg|thumb|right|260px|valentintournebize.]]
'''valentintournebize''' is a creator whose image is used on two [[Players Committee]] [[Virtual cards]].<ref name="cardlabels">[https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/resources/card_labels.json card_labels.json] in billbisco/swccg-gemp (commit 0bc4377d9): the printed labels of every Players Committee Virtual card, transcribed from the PC's card images (res.starwarsccg.org). Field definitions: [https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/docs/card_labels.md docs/card_labels.md].</ref> The cards print the credit as "Image courtesy of Jason Rucci, and valentintournebize @ Instagram" and "Image courtesy of valentintournebize @ Instagram". The credit points to Instagram, a photo-sharing site. The same credit line also names [[Jason Rucci]]. The credited cards are [[Life Day|•Life Day]] and [[Kashyyyk: Chewie's Hut|•Kashyyyk: Chewie's Hut]], in [[Virtual Set 23]] and [[Virtual Set 26]] (released 2024–2025).
